blocks.text: The National Athletics Association of Schools, Colleges and Universities (NAASCU) welcomes six new members when its opens its 24th season on Oct. 21 at the Makati Coliseum. ICI College, Gardner College, Philippine International College, Bestlink College, St. Bernadette of Lourdes College and Regis Marie College join the league, expanding the basketball field to 14 teams.
